_doc: Known XC course changes, each with a source. Venue (course-table display name) -> {'changes': [seasons a new course was first run], 'source': ...}; 'changes': [] records a venue confirmed never to have changed. Only add an entry when a source confirms it. Entries override automatic era detection (backend/xc_course_model.py).

Oxford Hills.source: Meets move to Roberts Farm, Norway: sub5 2012/XC/OHBoysOverall_sept21 header 'LOC: Roberts Farm' (9/21/2012), and Roberts Farm in every home-meet header 2015-2024; 2004-2011 files say 'at Oxford Hills'. Western Foothills Land Trust bought the farm in 2007 (https://www.nrcm.org/?p=83799)

South Portland.source: 2015: sub5 2016/XC/southportland_sept23.pdf '2.68 miles; new course as of 2015' (2.65 mi at SPHS 2007-2011). 2023: home meet moves to Wainwright Sports Complex, sub5 2023/XC/boys.txt & girls.txt header 'Wainwright Sports Complex' 5K (9/22/2023); earlier files say '@ South Portland High School' / 'SP Municipal Golf Course'

Freeport.source: Freeport XC race page (https://runinarace.rezdy.com/88893/freeport-xc-race): coaches began building a home course in 2008, before that home meets were at Pineland. Result files agree: 2007 and 9/12/2008 'Course: 3.1 Miles at Pinland Farm', 10/17/2008 'Freeport XC Trail', 2009-2015 'Pownal Road Field', 2016+ 'Hunter Road Fields'

Marshwood.source: 2010: sub5 2010/XC/marshwoodgirls_sept8.pdf '@ Vaughan Woods - NEW COURSE' (Vaughan Woods State Park also 2007-2009). 2017: sub5 2017/XC/XC-race-results-*-@-Marshwood 'Marshwood Great Works School Course'; the 2018 files say 'Marshwood Great Works School Course (new)'

Lee Academy.source: sub5 2011/XC/Lee%20Academy%20Invitational%20Meet%20Results 'New Course Distance: 2.7 Miles' (2009-2010 headers: 2.9 Miles); 2012/XC/leeinvite*.pdf 'Distance: 2.5 miles'

Orono High School.source: sub5 2012/XC/riot_challenge_boys_10.4.12.htm '2.8 mile Course (new course, new record)'; from 2014 the Riot Challenge says '4K Course'. Before that the 4K node held the 2005-2007 'PVC Regular Season Short Course' (2.5 mi)

Ellsworth High School.source: Ellsworth Invitational distance labels: '2.75 Mile Run CC' in 2003-2004 (sub5 ells03*/ells04*), 2007 JV and 2009 (MileSplit), then '3 Mile Run CC' from 2011 (MileSplit 2011, PVC 2012, 2014-2016) and 5K/3.11 mi from 2017. No 2010 meet in the store

Foxcroft Academy.source: sub5 2009/XC/foxcroftboys_sept18.htm 'Boys 2.75 Mile Run CC' (2008-2010 files carry a wrong '5k' event label); from 2012 the headers say '3.1 miles at Foxcroft Academy' | 2005: sub5 2005/XC/foxcroft9_6B '2.5 Mile Run CC'; 2007/XC/foxcroftboys9_18 header 'Short Course Meet' 2.5 mi; 2003/XC/foxcroft23sept03 '2.9 Mile Run CC', 2004/XC/foxcroft21sept04 '5000 Meter Dash' (Short course 2005-2007: labels 2.5 mi (factor 0.836); 2003-2004 were 2.9 mi / 5000 m) | 2008: sub5 2009/XC/foxcroftboys_sept18.htm 'Boys 2.75 Mile Run CC' (header 'Dover-Foxcroft, ME'); 2008/XC/foxcroft9_19 header 'Foxcroft Academy' (Back to the longer course 2008-2011 (2.75 mi; 2008-2010 files carry a wrong 5k label, factor 0.919); 2012 change already recorded)

Bangor High School.source: 2005: sub5 2004/XC/bangor8sept04b event '2.9 Mile Run CC'; 2005/XC/bangor9_7B '2.5 Mile Run CC'; 2006 '2.5', 2007 '2.56', 2009 '2.6', 2010 '2.56', 2011 '2.6 Mile Run CC' (Home course shortened: 2.9 mi in 2003-2004 to 2.5-2.6 mi 2005-2011 (factor 0.871 vs 1.002)) | 2012: sub5 2012/XC/bangorboys_august31.txt '3 Mile Run CC VARSITY' (header 'Bangor High School'); 2013 '3.05 Mile Run CC'; 2015, 2016 '3 Mile Run CC' (Back to a 3 mile course: labels 3.0-3.05 mi 2012-2016 (factor 1.002), also the 2003-2004 2.9 mi node) | 2017: sub5 2017/XC/bangorboys_sept1.txt event '5k Run CC' (header 'Bangor HS'); 5k in every home meet 2017-2026 (Course now run as 5K (factor 1.037, +3.5%))

Calais HS XC.source: 2026: MileSplit Calais Invitational: 2023-09-19 events '2.84 Mile Run CC' (meets/569694), 2026-09-22 events '5k Run CC' (meets/774425); both venue 'Calais HS XC' (2.84 mi in 2023 to 5K in 2026; factor ratio 1.11 matches the distance ratio 1.09, so the layout was lengthened (one race each year, no 2024-25 meet in the store))

Brunswick.source: no change: Brunswick HS's September home meet: header venue is Crystal Spring Farm in 2004, 2007, 2010 and 2013 and 'Spring Brook Farm' in 2005-2006 (same week each year, same Brunswick-hosted league meet); 2008-09 say 'Brunswick High School'. Brunswick (5K) shows no era (factor 1.009, 39 races). Treated as one course: Spring Brook Farm is a variant name, not a second place (no evidence of two layouts). (sub5 2004/XC/brunswick24sept04b 'CRYSTAL SPRING FARM - BRUNSWICK, ME'; 2005/XC/brunswick9_23B 'SPRING BROOK FARM - BRUNSWICK, ME'; 2007/XC/brunswickgirls9_20 'CRYSTAL SPRINGS FARM'; 2010/XC/brunswickboys_sept23, 2013/XC/brunswickgirls_sept26 'Crystal Spring Farm')

Central.source: no change: From 2016 the Central High School course is one layout of about 2.8 mi: labels 2.9 mi (2016), 5k (2017-18, 2025), 2.75/2.72 (2020-21), 2.83 (2022-23), 2.8 (2026), all headers 'Central High School'. The factor nodes 'Central (2.73 mi)', '(2.86 mi)' and '(5K)' split on label only. East Corinth (header) is this same school. (sub5 2016/XC/central-boys.txt '2.9 Mile Run' ... 2023/XC/central-boys.txt '2.83 Mile Run CC', each header 'Central High School'; 2019/XC/central-boys.txt.htm 'Central High School' while index says East Corinth)

Camden Hills.source: no change: 'Camden Hills (2.98 mi)' is the 2014 MileSplit Camden Hills Invitational, whose events are labelled '3 Mile Run CC' (2013 same meet '5k Run CC'): one season, 5.8% below the 5K node; a label/measure difference, not a new course. Headers 2011-2024 all say Camden Hills HS 5k. (MileSplit 2014 Camden Hills Invitational (meets/183388) events '3 Mile Run CC' vs 2013 (meets/151919) '5k Run CC'; sub5 2021/XC/camden-hills-boys.txt 'Camden Hills High School', 2024/XC/camden-hills-boys.txt 'Camden Hills HS')
